subject: integration
name: Data gathering standard (DATA_GATHERING_0_1)
summary: The row for the DATA_GATHERING_0_1 standard, which defines loading the content a record names, one file at a time and checked by its source. A standard defines a code without answering it: the row runs nothing, holds no state and makes no connection, and whatever answers the code is judged on its own row. Open source, and the definition is a JSON file in Orivon's source. Judged here by its publisher.
